name: Lightbox
description: Modal image viewer with keyboard navigation across a gallery of images.

keyboard: ArrowRight: advances to the next image
ArrowLeft: returns to the previous image
Tab: cycles focus within the panel while open
ariaRequirements: role=dialog with aria-modal=true on the panel
aria-label names the viewer and reports position in the set
Focus moves into the panel on open and returns to the trigger on close

governance.note: Promoted out of the bespoke/infrastructure exemption: a generic image viewer consumed by ProjectGallery and others, not app infrastructure. Already DS-shaped (CSS module, @dt/Icon, portal, focus restore). Alpha because forced-colors and light/dark are unverified.

content.voice: Captions describe the image, they do not narrate the interface.

terminology.rationale: Close is the conventional dialog dismissal label and is already translated in all three locales.

content.notes: Every image needs a real alt. A caption does not substitute for one: captions are visible to everyone, alt text carries the description for AT.
